sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:5

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:5:1
items.html: The souls of the righteous do not ascend in the secret of MAN upward, etc., except at night; but ZON ascend in the secret of MAN both by day and by night: This will be explained further on, page 1517, the passage beginning “And with this.”
